_readme: The Ugandan construction calendar: expos, CPD sessions, association meetings and site visits. Events disappear from the site the day after they end, like tenders and jobs. 'source' is where you found it — always link to the organiser rather than restating their terms. Set 'cpd' when the session carries formal CPD hours, because that is the reason most professionals click.

events.title: Uganda BuildExpo
events.blurb: Building materials, plant and finishes. Worth a morning if you are specifying for a project starting next year — most of the distributors you would otherwise chase by phone are in one hall.

events.title: ERB CPD: Structural detailing and site supervision
events.blurb: Full-day session counting toward the annual CPD requirement. Book early — these fill up in the last quarter when everyone realises they are short of hours.

events.title: Architects annual convention
events.blurb: Two days of practice, regulation and procurement sessions, and the one event where most of the registered practices are in the same room.

events.title: ISU surveyors' forum
events.blurb: Afternoon session on valuation practice and land tenure. Practical rather than ceremonial.

events.title: PPDA bidder clinic
events.organiser: Public Procurement and Disposal of Public Assets Authority
events.blurb: How to read a bid document and what gets submissions thrown out. If you have ever been disqualified on a technicality, this is the morning that explains why.

events.title: Eastern region materials day
events.blurb: Cement, steel, roofing and aggregate suppliers serving the eastern corridor. Smaller than the Kampala expos and easier to actually talk to people at.
